---
title: "Metastatic_sites"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-19"
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
meta_path <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/Metastasis.csv"
outdir    <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Read metadata
# -----------------------------
meta <- read_csv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Remove duplicated header rows if present
meta <- meta %>%
  filter(`Sample ID (TP number)` != "Sample ID (TP number)")

# Rename columns for convenience
meta <- meta %>%
  rename(
    id = `Sample ID (TP number)`,
    ER_Status = `ER Status`,
    HER2_Status = `HER-2 Status`,
    metastatic_sites = Metastatic_sites
  )

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Clean sample IDs and site strings
# -----------------------------
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    # remove trailing annotations like "(8)"
    id = str_remove(id, "\\s*\\(.*\\)$"),

    metastatic_sites = as.character(metastatic_sites),
    metastatic_sites = str_trim(metastatic_sites),

    # Normalize separators:
    # "bone and liver" -> "bone, liver"
    metastatic_sites = str_replace_all(metastatic_sites, "\\s+and\\s+", ", "),

    # Normalize comma spacing: "LN,bone" -> "LN, bone"
    metastatic_sites = str_replace_all(metastatic_sites, "\\s*,\\s*", ", "),

    # Collapse multiple spaces
    metastatic_sites = str_squish(metastatic_sites),

    # Optional: standardize case
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(metastatic_sites)
  )

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Expand to long format (one row per id x site)
# -----------------------------
meta_long <- meta %>%
  separate_rows(metastatic_sites, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = str_trim(metastatic_sites),
    metastatic_sites = str_squish(metastatic_sites)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(metastatic_sites), metastatic_sites != "")

# -----------------------------
# Summary: unique site types, top/least sites
# -----------------------------
n_sites <- n_distinct(meta_long$metastatic_sites)

top_sites <- meta_long %>%
  count(metastatic_sites, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

least_sites <- meta_long %>%
  count(metastatic_sites) %>%
  arrange(n) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Single-site vs multi-site samples
# -----------------------------
site_counts_per_sample <- meta_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(n_sites = n_distinct(metastatic_sites), .groups = "drop")

n_single <- sum(site_counts_per_sample$n_sites == 1)
n_multi  <- sum(site_counts_per_sample$n_sites > 1)

# List ids
single_site_ids <- site_counts_per_sample %>%
  filter(n_sites == 1) %>%
  pull(id)

multi_site_ids <- site_counts_per_sample %>%
  filter(n_sites > 1) %>%
  pull(id)


# Single-site combinations table
metastasis_single_site_combinations <- meta_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(metastatic_sites) == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(id, metastatic_sites)

# Multi-site combinations (useful to inspect)
multi_site_table <- meta_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sites = n_distinct(metastatic_sites),
    sites = paste(sort(unique(metastatic_sites)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_sites > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sites), id)
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Print key results
# -----------------------------
message("Unique metastatic site types: ", n_sites)
message("Samples with 1 site: ", n_single)
message("Samples with >1 site: ", n_multi)

message("\nTop 5 sites:")
print(top_sites)

message("\nLeast 5 sites:")
print(least_sites)

message("\nDistribution of n_sites per sample:")
print(site_counts_per_sample %>% count(n_sites, sort = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Save outputs for downstream work
# -----------------------------
write_csv(meta, file.path(outdir, "metastasis_meta_clean_wide.csv"))
write_csv(site_counts_per_sample, file.path(outdir, "metastasis_n_sites_per_sample.csv"))
write_csv(metastasis_single_site_combinations, file.path(outdir, "metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"))
write_csv(multi_site_table, file.path(outdir, "metastasis_multi_site_combinations.csv"))

message("\nWrote cleaned metadata + summaries to: ", outdir)

```
```{r}
ggplot(top_sites, aes(x = reorder(metastatic_sites, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site",
    y = "Number of samples",
    title = "Top 5 metastatic sites"
  )
```
